scope: Independent static inspection of the completed APK, not runtime validation
method: Python stdlib SHA-256/ZIP CRC/ELF header and literal bytes, Android aapt/apksigner
limitations: No Android device or emulator attached; installation, launch, bridge, and GPS are untested.
No embedded offline Web bundle is expected; genuine offline operation is not passed.
A release-mode APK may retain a debug signing certificate; nondebuggable is a separate check.
Source HEAD and a matching build receipt do not prove a reproducible build.

assets.web_assets_explanation: All packaged HTML/CSS/JS belongs to plugin packages; no application Web offline bundle is packaged.
assets.source_asset_path_normalization: Archive names are URI-encoded; five source SVG filenames contain spaces encoded as %20. Actual archived payload SHA-256 is compared for every source asset.
